prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1441; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for making time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the facts. I'm the driver of the blue sedan involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?

A: It was on the access road in Sugar Land, Texas, near a shopping center. I was moving from the right lane over to the left to get into the turn lane.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I checked my mirror, didn't see anything, and signaled. I started to move over slowly. Then I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed toward the curb.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point before contact?

A: Not that I recall. I think it was in my blind spot. It came up on my passenger side, and I didn't notice it until the contact.

Q: Were you able to stop or steer away?

A: I tried to correct back toward my lane, but there wasn't enough time. Both cars ended up stopped on the shoulder.

Q: How are you feeling physically since the collision?

A: My neck is sore and stiff, mostly on the left side. I've had some tightness across my shoulders too. I went to urgent care that same day and was told it looked like a neck strain. I'm taking over-the-counter pain relievers and trying to keep moving as much as I can.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or shoulder problems?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago after a long drive, but it went away on its own.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was being careful and signaled before I moved. I'd like the claim handled fairly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
